title: Distributed EEG phase-resetting dynamics predict depressive symptom severity in untreated adults
abstract: Nature Mental Health, Published online: 05 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s44220-026-00757-8 This research identifies a neurometric signature for depressive symptom severity using phase-resetting rate modulation in untreated adults. An integrated index demonstrates strong predictive accuracy, suggesting potential for objective assessment and monitoring, pending further validation in clinical settings.
